sentences.text:
Mr. U.C. Jena, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opp. Party
 Mr. M.K. Mohanty, Asc
 Mr. G.P. Mohanty, Adv for the Informant
 Coram:
 Justice Chittaranjan Dash
 Order
Order No. 20.04.2023
02. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.

2. By means of this application, the Petitioner seeks grant of anticipatory bail Under Section. 438 of Cr.P.C. in apprehension of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences under Sections 376(2)(n)/420/506 of IPC corresponding to G.R Case No. 564 of 2023 arising out of Bhadrak Rural P.S Case No. 143 of 2023 pending in the file of learned S.D.J.M., Bhadrak.

entities.text: Bhadrak Rural P.S Case No. 143 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. Perusal of the FIR reveals that the Informant had married to one Santosh Kumar Sankhua in the year 2012.

Subsequently, she got the divorce from him and came in contact of the present Petitioner,
who kept relations with the informant without her consent.
Later, the Petitioner got married to the Informant in the Lokantah Temple of Bhadrak.
When the Informant told the Petitioner to register the marriage, the Petitioner denied and threatened the Informant to do away with her life.

Keeping in view the submission of the parties, the nature of allegations as emerged from the materials on record, the circumstances appearing, the seriousness and gravity of the offences, this court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the Petitioner.
Accordingly the prayer for bail stands rejected and the ABLAPL is dismissed.
